# hetznerrobot_ssh_key (Data Source)

Reads one SSH key stored in Robot, by `fingerprint` or by `name` (exactly one of them).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hetznerrobot_ssh_key" "admin" {
  name = "admin"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `fingerprint` (String) MD5 fingerprint of the key.
- `name` (String) Name of the key.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation date.
- `data` (String) Public key in OpenSSH format.
- `size` (Number) Key size in bits.
- `type` (String) Key algorithm, e.g. `ED25519`.
